patch_resolves_note: The staged `patch.diff` does not apply to the Stage 01 checkout, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative `n132/arvo:42530108-fix` image. On the original PoC that image keeps the same `sd_extent_guard` values (`dataLen=41`, `required_extent=68`) but never reaches `entry_parse_begin`, making the repaired path guarded. The nearest valid boundary mutation (`options_len_5_one_valid_option`) collapses the required extent to 41 and does reach `entry_parse_begin` on the fixed image, providing a genuine witness that the fixed build blocks the original truncated-options path specifically; it then still crashes on the separate `lenEntries < sizeof(someipsdhdrentry)` underflow path, which is outside this frozen invariant set.

nodes.description: Source. `getLenEntries()` is the first project read that materializes a vulnerability-relevant length from the SOME/IP-SD payload. On the exact witness it reads `lenEntries == 8`, which later drives both validation and `getEntries()` even though one `someipsdhdrentry` is 16 bytes.

nodes.description: Root cause. `isDataValid()` compares the 41-byte SOME/IP-SD buffer length only against the raw options-length field `32`, instead of against the full extent `sizeof(someipsdhdr) + sizeof(uint32_t) + lenEntries + sizeof(uint32_t) + lenOptions == 68`, so it accepts a truncated layer.

ASan crash site. On the second `getEntries()` iteration, `getTtl()` dereferences `majorVersion_ttl` of `SomeIpSdEntry(this, 40)` after `remainingLen` wrapped and `offset` advanced beyond the real 8-byte entries region.

nodes.state: After the first entry length is subtracted, the unsigned `remainingLen` loop counter wraps upward from the declared 8-byte entries span to `SIZE_MAX-7`, leaving `offset` advanced to the next out-of-region entry base.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `first_entry_advance.remainingLen_before=8` and `first_entry_advance.remainingLen_after=18446744073709551608`.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records equal pointers at `first_entry_advance.entry_ptr_after` and `ttl_sink.entry_ptr`.
The vulnerable original trace records `sd_extent_guard.lenEntries=8` and `first_entry_advance.remainingLen_before=8`.
